title: I lost my phone, can you turn off two-factor?
group: It hands it to a person
latency_basis: the gap before each call's llm_call event in the original recording

input.message: hey so this is annoying but i lost my phone yesterday (left it in a rideshare, still trying to get it back) and obviously that had my authenticator app on it. can you just disable mfa on my account for now so i can actually log in and get some work done today? i'll set it back up once i get a new phone

calls.output: {"category":"escalate","rationale":"This is a request to disable MFA due to a lost device, which per Section 7 and Section 11 must always be escalated to a human on the Security team for in-person/video identity verification and cannot be actioned via chat or ticket under any circumstances.","confidence":0.99}
